answers.rationale: The requirement specifies technical parameters for medium-voltage switchgear, including short-circuit current, MVA class, and interrupting time. These align with the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product, which is an arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear designed for such applications.

The requirement describes features of circuit breakers, such as independent trip coils and compatibility. These features are typically part of the CROWN-ARMV product, which includes vacuum circuit breakers as part of its medium-voltage switchgear lineup.
The low-frequency test voltage requirement is a standard specification for medium-voltage switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is designed to meet such electrical performance standards.
The basic impulse level (BIL) requirement is a standard specification for medium-voltage switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is engineered to meet such BIL ratings.
The nominal voltage supplies and ranges for closing, tripping, and charging motors are typical for medium-voltage switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes these features as part of its design.
